Element.attribute: APR 2017 - removed reference to "project management plan component" |SEPT 2015- added main description and outline

The cost management plan establishes:

  1. level of accuracy and level of precision
  2. unit of measurement
  3. WBS procedure links to control account
  4. control thresholds
  5. earned value rules of performance, reporting, funding and processes
  6. life cycle costing = total cost of ownership: production cost, running and maintenance cost, etc.

To establish cost:

  • units of measure
  • levels of precision
  • level of accuracy
  • procedures and framework
  • control thresholds

This plan includes:

  • level of accuracy
  • units of measure
  • control thresholds
  • rules for performance measurement
  • estimating costs
  • details for developing the budget
